mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inquiry (user_id, supplier_id, product_id, quantity, content, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{supplierId}, #{productId}, #{quantity}, #{content}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT inquiry_id AS inquiryId, user_id AS userId, supplier_id AS supplierId, product_id AS productId, quantity, content, status, created_at AS createdAt FROM inquiry WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT inquiry_id AS inquiryId, user_id AS userId, supplier_id AS supplierId, product_id AS productId, quantity, content, status, created_at AS createdAt FROM inquiry WHERE inquiry_id = #{inquiryId}
